explorationReceipt.scope: approximately 43 named track and release listings across 17 official artist, label, retailer, catalogue, and bounded-query result pages screened across all three required source families

currentReleases: 2026-08-01 through 2026-08-28 window; approximately 20 named tracks across seven official release pages and four bounded searches
Official Poliritmic Dry Matter Fuzai O / Cat Girl: https://poliritmic.bandcamp.com/album/fuzai-o-cat-girl
adjacentAndEmerging: Approximately 12 named tracks across five official independent artist and label pages plus four bounded searches emphasizing restraint, persistent groove, spatial rhythm, dub depth, and controlled development
Official Apnea Der Schall & Klang Intuition: https://apnealabel.bandcamp.com/album/intuition
Official Arms & Legs Hypnotic Image Hypno Grooves: https://armsandlegsrecords.bandcamp.com/album/hypno-grooves
Official Mona Records Pol// Stellar EP: https://monarecords.bandcamp.com/album/pol-stellar-ep
overlookedCatalogue: Approximately 11 named tracks across five official catalogue pages and four bounded exact-track or tempo searches covering 2025–2026 minimal looping techno, dub pressure, gradual repetition, and reduced club tools
Beatport Reger Star Lane Skog listing: https://www.beatport.com/genre/techno-peak-time-driving/6/tracks?page=3&per_page=25

exclusions: Every lead and candidate in prior immutable requests through 2026-08-19, including Mitra — Hush, was excluded, together with all 26 canonical identities, durable rejected entries, frozen Session 4 material, protected Deep Under → Wurk opening handoff, Iruka summit, protected ending, and untriggered PARKED entries.

Harmony, kurir, Amsys, Pol// and Pyramidal Decode material was excluded where official text foregrounded heavyweight, fast, peak-time, industrial, complex-synth, or overtly dramatic behaviour, or where track-specific evidence and exact tempo were insufficient.
Dry Matter and Hypnotic Image material was excluded because the official framing is minimal house or tech house, leaving canonical techno belonging unsupported despite groove-oriented language.

Shadow Dynamics — Static Ritual and Der Schall & Klang — Intuition were excluded to avoid padding: both have constitution-relevant exact-track descriptions, but no reliable exact BPM source established a concrete legal non-protected path; Intuition also repeated the unresolved dub-space question already parked for RÖM — Whispering Dub.
Inbargeh — Retreat was excluded because the official release gives only a 130–140 BPM range rather than exact track tempo, preventing a lawful exact-neighbour test without inventing a value.

Reger — Anesidora Dub and Vent were excluded because exact BPM was unavailable; FM-E was excluded because its official description emphasizes quick, wriggly dancefloor entertainment rather than restraint.
No lead was admitted for novelty, release recency, popularity, duration, BPM, key, artist reputation, label reputation, or quota completion.
explorationReceipt.evidenceLimit: Official release text plus exact retailer identity, duration, and tempo metadata only; no Spotify audio analysis, no raw-audio measurement, and no candidate-specific listener report.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.

warnings.warning: Exact title/artist matched with release metadata variance: album requested "FM-E EP" but Spotify returned "Star Lane Skog"; release date requested "2026-08-07" but Spotify returned "2026-07-16"
